SalesMethodologyDefItem.name: SalesMethodologyDefItem
SalesMethodologyDefItem.description: Represents the individual criteria for each stage of a sales methodology.

Description.description: Details about a specific stage or criteria of a sales methodology and its purpose.

DeveloperName.description: The unique name for the sales methodology stage or criteria. The name: must be 40 characters or fewer must begin with a letter can contain only underscores and alphanumeric characters can't include spaces can't end with an underscore can't contain 2 consecutive underscores In managed packages, this field prevents naming conflicts on package installations. With this field, a developer can change the object's name in a managed package and the changes are reflected in a subscriber's organization.

InputType.description: Required. Indicates the input type of the sales methodology criteria.

IsActive.description: Required. Indicates if the sales methodology criteria is active (true) or not (false).

Language.description: The combined language and locale ISO code, which controls the language of the sales methodology item.

MasterLabel.description: Required. The label for the sales methodology stage or criteria. This display value is the internal label that doesn't get translated.

MaxValue.description: Defines the upper bound for numeric input items. It applies when InputType is a numeric type (e.g., a slider or score field). When InputType is not numeric (e.g., picklist, boolean, text), MaxValue is not used. .

SalesMethodologyDefId.description: Required. The ID of the parent sales methodology definition.

ShortHand.description: Required. The initial that represents the methodology stage or criteria.

SortOrder.description: Required. The display order number of the sales methodology stage or criteria.

SalesMethodologyDefItem.accessRules: userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled, OrgPreferences, SalesMethodologyPref, and PipelineInspectorUser permissions. To read records, users must have the userHasSalesMethodologyEnabled permission. To create, edit, or delete records, users must have the CustomizeApplication
